hooks.name: sdda-preflight_agent_bounds
hooks.command: SDDA_HARNESS=gemini-cli ${SDDA_PYTHON:-python} "$GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR/.sdda/python/sdda_hooks/preflight_agent_bounds.py"; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ $rc -ne 2 ]; then echo "[hook] preflight_agent_bounds.py ne demarre pas (code $rc) - interpreteur: SDDA_PYTHON=${SDDA_PYTHON:-python}" >&2; if [ "${SDDA_HOOKS_STRICT:-0}" = "1" ]; then exit 2; fi; fi; exit $rc
